✍️ Text & MetaText Components

Select a mode below to review use case scenarios across Forms, Tables, and Charts.

1. Forms: Simple Text Field

Standard single-value input with native browser ergonomics, validation, and HTMX auto-save.

Standard Form

Captures a single standalone string value ("David Jeba").

Code Sample HTML / HTMX 
<!-- Simple Textbox -->
<label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">Patient Full Legal Name</label>
<input type="text" 
       name="patient_name" 
       value="David Jeba" 
       hx-post="/api/patients/name" 
       hx-trigger="change" 
       class="h-10 w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900" />

Hyperstack Meta Component

Strict 2x2 Guardrails & 50% Typography Ratio

Fits in the exact 40px (h-10) vertical budget of a simple textbox. Max 2 cells top, max 2 cells bottom. Zero gap.

h-10 (40px) 0px Gap 50% Font

1. Forms: MetaText Compound Field

Packs UHID, Triage, Editable Patient Name, Age (red font alert), and Sex into one 40px form slot.

Compound Form Input
UHID: 1221 TRIAGE: LEVEL 2
Pt -
AGE: 45 YRS SEX: Male

⚡ Exact same 40px height as a standard textbox; stores 4 linked clinical attributes.

Code Sample Go DSL & Declarative HTML 
// Go DSL (One-line Shorthand with !red color modifier)
components.MetaTextField("UHID: 1221, TRIAGE: LEVEL 2 | [@pt_name: David Jeba] | AGE: 45!red, SEX: Male")

<!-- Declarative HTML Component -->
<div class="hs-metatext inline-flex flex-col justify-between h-10 w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white">
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x border-b text-[8px] font-mono uppercase px-2 h-[11px] items-center leading-none bg-slate-50">
    <span>UHID: 1221</span>
    <span class="text-right text-amber-600 font-bold">TRIAGE: LEVEL 2</span>
  </div>
  <div class="px-2 flex items-center h-[18px] bg-white leading-none">
    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 mr-1">Pt -</span>
    <input type="text" name="pt_name" value="David Jeba" class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 bg-transparent border-0 p-0 m-0 leading-none focus:outline-none" />
  </div>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x border-t text-[8px] font-mono uppercase px-2 h-[11px] items-center leading-none bg-slate-50">
    <span>AGE: <strong class="text-red-600 font-bold">45</strong></span>
    <span class="pl-1">SEX: <strong class="text-slate-900">Male</strong></span>
  </div>
</div>

Code Sample Go DSL Table Composition 
// 3 MetaText Components in a Single High-Density Table Row
TableRow(
  TableCell("ICU-01"),
  components.MetaTextField("UHID: 1221 | [Pt - David Jeba] | AGE: 45!red, SEX: Male"),
  components.MetaTextField("[Ortho] | [Dr. Sarah Jenkins] | [Degree] MS, FACS"),
  components.MetaTextField("ADMIT DATE | [20-Nov-2026] | [10:45 AM]"),
  Badge("Pre-Op", "amber"),
)

<!-- Client-side Tab Switcher Script -->
<script>
  function switchTextTab(tab) {
    const btnText = document.getElementById('btn-tab-textfield');
    const btnMeta = document.getElementById('btn-tab-metatext');
    const paneText = document.getElementById('pane-textfield');
    const paneMeta = document.getElementById('pane-metatext');

    if (tab === 'metatext') {
      btnMeta.className = "px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all bg-white text-indigo-700 shadow-xs";
      btnText.className = "px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900";
      paneMeta.classList.remove('hidden');
      paneText.classList.add('hidden');
      if (window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
        const url = new URL(window.location);
        url.searchParams.set('tab', 'metatext');
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
      }
    } else {
      btnText.className = "px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs";
      btnMeta.className = "px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900";
      paneText.classList.remove('hidden');
      paneMeta.classList.add('hidden');
      if (window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
        const url = new URL(window.location);
        url.searchParams.set('tab', 'textfield');
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
      }
    }
  }

  // Auto-detect tab from URL query params (e.g., ?tab=metatext) or hash
  (function initTab() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.get('tab') === 'metatext' || window.location.hash === '#metatext' || window.location.pathname.includes('/metatext')) {
      switchTextTab('metatext');
    }
  })();
</script>
